items.title: Landfill search for First Nation woman's remains in Thunder Bay, Ont., comes up empty
items.description: After a nearly month-long search of the city’s landfill, Deborah Anishinabie’s family is still seeking closure as an investigation into her homicide in Thunder Bay, Ont., continues.
